entries.note: 36.3 cm3; rule-based: the pelvic muscle funnel medial to the obturator internus band, between the pubic arch's apex and 0 mm above the ischial spine; pubococcygeus, puborectalis and iliococcygeus are NOT separated (no septum between them at 1 mm). REVIEW (main session 2026-09-16): levator ani bilateral 62.7 cm3 against the 19.8-46.6 cm3 of the MRI series (Fielding, PMID 10701604): the rule gives a 10-13 mm sheet where Gray's describes 3-5 mm, so it carries some anorectal wall and fat.

4.0 cm3; rule-based: the sheet posterior to the anal canal from the ischial spine down 18 mm towards the coccyx. Her coccyx is NOT labelled, so the posterior anchor is a 14 mm pad of the bony hull; the septum ratio against the levator ani is only just above the merge threshold, so the coccygeus / iliococcygeus cut is the rule's, not a septum's.

2.7 cm3; rule-based: flanking the vaginal opening, in the superficial perineal pouch. It is the muscle TOGETHER WITH the vestibular bulb it covers: erectile tissue photographs as dark as striated muscle at 1 mm and the two have no septum between them, so the shipped mass is larger than the muscle alone.

2.7 cm3; rule-based: on the ischiopubic ramus, in the superficial perineal pouch. 1.9 cm3; rule-based: position-rule marker relative to her bone and organ labels, boundary by the marker watershed on the pale septa of her cryosection photographs.
